service.method: SELECT COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME , HOUSE_CODE AS SERVICE_CODE FROM USERVICE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${SERVICE_CODE} AND (COMPANY_CODE LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR COMPANY_NAME LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%') AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY COMPANY_CODE ASC
